openawf: 0.1.0
name: pr-review
summary: Review a pull request against the repository's review guidelines and post the findings.
model: anthropic/claude-sonnet-5
license: Apache-2.0
version: 0.1.0
sha: null

start: gather
orchestration:
  gather: review
  review:
    pass: approve
    changes: comment
  approve: null
  comment: null

tasks:
  gather:
    summary: Collect the diff and the review guidelines.
    max-turns: 20
    timeout: 300000
    uses: [github/get_pull_request, github/get_pull_request_diff, files]
    input:
      type: object
      properties:
        pull-request:
          type: string
          description: The URL of the pull request to review.
      required: [pull-request]
    body: |
      # Gather

      Read the pull request {{pull-request}} and its diff. Read REVIEW.md at the repository
      root. Return the diff and the guidelines.

  review:
    summary: Judge the diff against the guidelines.
    outcomes:
      pass:
        type: object
        properties:
          summary: { type: string }
        required: [summary]
      changes:
        type: object
        properties:
          unmet:
            type: array
            items:
              type: object
              properties:
                guideline: { type: string }
                file: { type: string }
                reason: { type: string }
              required: [guideline, file, reason]
        required: [unmet]
    effort: high
    body: |
      # Review

      Check the diff against each guideline. Emit `pass` when every guideline
      is met. Otherwise emit `changes` and return the unmet guidelines with
      the lines involved.

  approve:
    summary: Approve the pull request.
    uses: [github/create_pull_request_review]
    body: |
      # Approve

      Approve the pull request with a one-line summary of what was checked.

  comment:
    summary: Request changes with the review notes.
    uses: [github/create_pull_request_review]
    body: |
      # Comment

      Submit a review that requests changes. List each unmet guideline with
      the lines involved.

mcp:
  github:
    type: http
    url: https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}"
    allow: [get_pull_request, get_pull_request_diff, create_pull_request_review]
    timeout: 60000

  files:
    type: stdio
    package:
      registry-type: npm
      identifier: "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem"
      version: 2.0.0
    args: ["${REPO_DIR}"]
    allow: [read_file, list_directory]
